sources.title: mindee/doctr: docTR (Document Text Recognition) - GitHub
sources.snippet: Quick Tour Getting your pretrained model End-to-End OCR is achieved in docTR using a two-stage approach: text detection (localizing words), then text recognition (identify all characters in the word). As such, you can select the architecture used for text detection, and the one for text recognition from the list of available implementations.
